primary.title: Credit card stolen and money spent: Will the bank refund the loss, or will you have to pay the bill?
primary.summary: A stolen credit card can quickly turn into a financial nightmare. Whether the bank refunds fraudulent spending or the customer bears the loss depends on how the fraud occurred and crucially how quickly it was reported.
